title: India's PLI schemes hit 76% of their investment target. Jobs are a different story.

caption:
India's Production Linked Incentive schemes promised investment, output, and jobs. A new government assessment shows which of those three actually showed up.

Investment reached Rs 2.4 lakh crore - 76% of target. Production and sales hit Rs 22.6 lakh crore - 64% of target.

Jobs are the weak link: 8.49 lakh created against a target of 30.2 lakh - just 28%. NITI Aayog's own report flags underperformers including bulk drugs exports, medical device employment, and IT hardware investment.

A scheme that moved money and output faster than jobs. That's not a failure, but it's not the full promise either.

Sources: NITI Aayog (with IIM Ahmedabad), ThePrint, Free Press Journal (November 2026)
